issues.description: Two proof lemmas carry unnecessary per-item `non_snake_case` lint suppressions.
issues.rationale: The reviewer questions the first allowance, and the next PR commit is explicitly titled `fix: remove unnecessary #[allow(non_snake_case)]`, removing both identical attributes while leaving the lemma names unchanged. The final approved head contains neither suppression. With neither item triggering the lint, neither requires a suppression under narrow-lint-suppressions.
